name: Cronex Chaikin
summary: This EA trades based on the Cronex Chaikin indicator, which is a modified Chaikin Oscillator that smooths the accumulation/distribution flow using moving averages. It generates buy and sell signals from crossover events of the Chaikin oscillator lines, entering positions when momentum shifts in the market. The EA is a systematic momentum-based trading system with configurable lot sizing and stop loss parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Cronex Chaikin指标进行交易，该指标是经过移动平均平滑处理的改良版Chaikin震荡器。通过Chaikin震荡线的交叉事件产生买卖信号，在市场动量发生转变时开仓。该EA是一个系统化的动量交易系统，具有可配置的手数和止损参数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Chaikin震荡器，该指标通过计算累积/分布线的移动平均差值来衡量市场资金流向和动量变化。入场条件为Cronex Chaikin指标的主线与信号线发生交叉——主线上穿信号线时做多，下穿信号线时做空。出场条件依赖止损和止盈的设定，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由MoneyFix参数控制每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的动量跟踪系统，但依赖单一指标信号可能导致震荡行情中频繁虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Chaikin Oscillator, which measures market money flow and momentum shifts by calculating the difference between moving averages of the accumulation/distribution line. Entry conditions are triggered when the Cronex Chaikin main line crosses its signal line — a bullish crossover generates a buy signal while a bearish crossover generates a sell signal. Exit conditions rely on configured stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closure on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach controlled by the MoneyFix parameter for each trade. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear as a typical momentum-following system, but reliance on a single indicator can lead to frequent false signals during ranging markets.

pros: 使用Chaikin震荡器捕捉资金流向变化，逻辑具有金融理论基础
策略概念简洁明了，信号规则清晰，易于理解和验证
提供止损和止盈参数，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Uses the Chaikin Oscillator to capture money flow shifts, grounded in established financial theory
Strategy concept is clean and straightforward with clear signal rules that are easy to understand and verify
Provides stop loss and take profit parameters, establishing a basic risk control framework
cons: 仅依赖单一指标信号，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
采用固定手数而非动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自动调整仓位大小
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓造成过度交易
没有点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在不利市场条件下仍会进场
cons_en: Relies on a single indicator for signals, prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Uses fixed lot sizing instead of dynamic position management, unable to automatically adjust size based on account risk
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar causing overtrading
No spread filter or trading session filter, will enter trades even under unfavorable market conditions
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认和辅助指标过滤，减少震荡行情中的虚假信号
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数方式
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation and auxiliary indicator filtering to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage instead of fixed lot sizing

risk_points: 单一指标在震荡市中会产生大量虚假信号导致连续止损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一K线重复开仓
固定手数无法适应不同账户规模和波动环境
risk_points_en: Single indicator generates numerous false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive stop losses
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position openings on the same bar
Fixed lot sizing cannot adapt to different account sizes and volatility environments
